Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Acme  Cloud TCO & Cost Optimization (token economics)

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand the production constraints and budget guardrails. Quick recap of the key points we heard and the recommended levers we discussed for reducing per-token cost while preserving quality: 

Pain points / goals
- High query volume from chat (real-time assistance) with peak bursts during product launches
- Avg request: ~1.2k input tokens + 200 tokens generated (est) -> ~1.4k total
- Target: keep monthly inference spend <= $35k while improving latency under 350ms P95
- Need predictable TCO for Q3 planning and a low-friction pilot path

Cost / TCO levers we recommended
- Model & quantization: evaluate 7B q4o vs 3B q4o for similar quality at lower throughput cost
- Batching & concurrency: modest batching (batch sizes 4-8) for asynchronous routes; keep low latency sync endpoints unbatched
- Prefix/KV caching: cache common prompts and session history for repeat flows (TTL 30-60m) - can reduce tokens by ~20-30% on typical traffic mix
- Hybrid routing: route low-latency customers to hot pool (higher cost), bulk requests to lower-cost capacity or cached responses
- Token-level optimizations: prompt compression and stop sequence tuning to reduce generation length by 10-15%

Initial numbers (rough)
- Current monthly tokens (est): 35-50M tokens -> current spend estimate aligned to your reported numbers
- Target with levers: 20-30M tokens equivalent (30-40% reduction) -> model-dependent cost savings of ~30-45%

Next steps we agreed on
1) I'll send a short TCO workbook and our pricing options (attached).
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with Dev (engineering) to validate batching/caching approach and integration model.
3) We'll propose a 3-month pilot plan with clear RX metrics and a cost cap to match your budget.

Attachments: acme_tco_summary.xlsx, redwood_pricing_options.pdf (pricing sheet + example pilot SOW)

If I missed anything or got the numbers off, please correct. Happy to tighten the per-request token estimate if you can share a few representative logs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Perfect - thanks for clarifying the split between web and mobile. That helps a lot. I attached a quick worksheet that models three scenarios (current, optimized w/3B q4 + caching, optimized w/7B q4 + batching). High-level example numbers below (very rough but should be directionally useful):

Scenario A - Current (no caching, current model)\- Monthly tokens: 45M\- Estimated monthly cost: $48k
\Scenario B - 3B q4 + prefix caching (30% token reduction)\- Monthly tokens: 31.5M\- Estimated monthly cost: $29k
\Scenario C - 7B q4 + batching/caching (40% token reduction, higher per-token cost but fewer tokens)\- Monthly tokens: 27M\- Estimated monthly cost: $32k

Assumptions shown in the workbook; primary drivers are per-token price differential and expected token reductions from caching + generation length tuning.

Immediate recommendations
- Pilot on 3B q4 with prefix caching for FAQ and session-based flows (best near-term chance of hitting the $35k cap).
- Dev: can we set aside a 60-90 minute deep-dive next week to validate integration work (SDK, cache TTL, batching configs)?
- Sales: we'll propose a 3-month pilot at the numbers in the attached pricing sheet and include a clause for cost cap/overage notifications.

Rishi is on this thread for any infra-level questions; Dev will lead the integration call.
